fact: The FY2023 statements, dated 25 March 2024, state that payroll runs on the IFMIS HR/Payroll system with all categories except Foreign Mission salaries processed by Electronic Fund Transfer, and that EFT was extended to more MDAs in 2023.
title: General Purpose Financial Statements of the Consolidated Fund for the year ended 31st December 2023
publisher: Accountant General's Department, Government of Sierra Leone
